title: Stress-test a regenerative claim
description: Select an environmental use case and intervention, then add demand growth and evidence. The lab keeps the AI service footprint separate from the external outcome it may support.

scenarios.label: Habitat restoration
scenarios.detail: Prioritize field inspections and restoration sites while local teams retain the decision.

scenarios.label: Grid maintenance
scenarios.detail: Rank inspection work that can prevent equipment faults and wasted renewable generation.

scenarios.label: Water leak triage
scenarios.detail: Prioritize investigations from noisy sensor data without treating a prediction as a repair.

interventions.label: Right-size and gate inference
interventions.detail: Use the smallest sufficient model, cache safe results, and skip low-value calls.

interventions.label: Shift deferrable compute
interventions.detail: Move flexible training or batch work to a lower-carbon time without hiding service demand.

interventions.label: Improve the field decision
interventions.detail: Change prioritization so constrained field capacity reaches more high-value interventions.

interventions.label: Combine reduction and contribution
interventions.detail: Right-size the service and validate a separate field outcome with accountable operators.

evidenceLevels.label: Modeled estimate
evidenceLevels.detail: Engineering assumptions without an observed counterfactual.

evidenceLevels.label: Measured pilot
evidenceLevels.detail: Instrumented deployment with a documented baseline and uncertainty.

evidenceLevels.label: Independent review
evidenceLevels.detail: Reproducible measurements, counterfactual analysis, and external assurance.
